ops.loadingHours: If there is load-in or load-out, an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date. If it is not submitted, the loading area cannot be used. The loading area is used only for loading and unloading. Load-in and load-out vehicles must enter and leave within the usage time. The person in charge on site checks in and out at the service center on the 1F of Sumitomo Fudosan Shinjuku Central Park Building before and after the work. Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. (Source: Terms of Use, 2026 edition)
ops.vehicleRules: There is a load-in and loading route where a 10-ton truck can park directly. Parking at the loading area is only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking, parking outside the designated parking lot, and roadside parking around the building are prohibited. Enter the vehicle type, vehicle size and number of vehicles on the advance load-in notice.
ops.parking: For nearby parking lots, the official guidance is to search for "Bellesalle Shinjuku Central Park" on the website of the Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation (s-park).
ops.waitingRooms: There are 2 waiting rooms. Waiting Room 1 is 36㎡ and Waiting Room 2 is 17㎡, and the usage fee is 0 yen for each. The waiting rooms cannot be used on their own.
ops.catering: The Event Hall operates under a comprehensive management system (designated vendor system), in which setup and removal are carried out by the operator's designated vendors. If a vendor other than the designated ones is used, a bring-in fee applies. For bringing in rental items, the fee is 55,000 yen including tax for a venue area of up to 1,000㎡ and 110,000 yen including tax for 1,001 to 1,500㎡. For bringing in setup and construction work, the fee is 165,000 yen including tax for up to 1,000㎡. The outside food/drink fee applies only to party use, and is 440,000 yen including tax for up to 1,200㎡ (bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered; under the terms of use, the event space is excluded).
